entities.createSql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` USING FTS4(`ocrText` TEXT NOT NULL, tokenize=unicode61, content=`history`)
contentSyncTriggers: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_history_fts_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON `history` BEGIN DELETE FROM `history_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_history_fts_BEFORE_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON `history` BEGIN DELETE FROM `history_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_history_fts_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON `history` BEGIN INSERT INTO `history_fts`(`docid`, `ocrText`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`ocrText`); END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_history_fts_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON `history` BEGIN INSERT INTO `history_fts`(`docid`, `ocrText`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`ocrText`); END
